parsed.post: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 significantly reduced val_bpb from 1.1078 to 1.0178. I'm now going to probe the optimal learning rate for this deeper configuration. Since depth increased the parameter count, I might need to adjust MATRIX_LR.
parsed.description: Increased depth to 6 and increased MATRIX_LR to 0.12 to see if the larger model can handle a higher learning rate within the 5-minute budget.
